blocks.text: Several Filipino artists, including Ben&Ben and Maymay Entrata, are vying for a spot in the 2027 Grammy race as they submitted their respective entries for consideration. The folk-pop band is eyeing for nomination in the Best Pop Group/Duo Performance with the reimagined version of their hit song “Leaves.” “Suntok sa buwan, imposibleng pangarap, pero susubok pa rin! Salamat sa paglipad kasama namin, Liwanag,” the group said on its social media pages, addressing their fans.
